page_text_ocr_zh:
北魏时期，北方柔然族经常侵犯国家边境。
柔然族的军队突袭了长城，一路南下，烧杀抢掠，
眼看就要到达中原了。君王召集朝中大臣商议对策。
“国势危急，所有军队必须严阵以待，时刻准备
好抵御侵略。”“陛下，现我国兵力严重不足。”“速速
传旨，招募士兵，扩充军队！”
page_text_en:
During the Northern Wei period, the Rouran tribe from the north frequently invaded the country's borders.
The Rouran army launched a surprise attack on the Great Wall, advancing southward, burning, killing, and looting,
and was about to reach the Central Plains. The king summoned court ministers to discuss countermeasures.
"The situation is critical. All troops must be on high alert and ready at any moment to resist the invasion."
"Your Majesty, our current military strength is severely insufficient."
"Hurry and issue an order: recruit soldiers and expand the army!"
summary_zh: 本页描绘了北魏时期柔然族入侵，君王召集大臣商议对策，决定招募士兵扩充军队以抵御侵略的场景。

page_text_ocr_zh:
河南虞城，有一位女子，名叫花木兰，她的父亲花弧年轻时曾为国参战。
木兰从小喜欢跟在父亲身后偷偷地练武，还会取来父亲的兵器耍弄操练。
“快看啊，花木兰又在偷偷舞剑了。”“真好笑，昨天我还看到她射箭呢！”
街坊邻居常常笑话木兰。他们认为，女孩子应该知书达理，温柔贤惠，从小学习女红。天天这样舞刀弄枪，只怕以后嫁不出去。可木兰并不在意别人的看法。
page_text_en:
In Yucheng, Henan, there was a girl named Hua Mulan. Her father, Hua Hu, had once fought for the country in his youth.
Mulan loved to secretly practice martial arts behind her father, even taking his weapons to practice.
"Look, Mulan is secretly practicing swordplay again!" "How funny, I saw her shooting arrows yesterday!"
The neighbors often laughed at Mulan. They believed girls should be well-mannered, gentle, and kind, learning needlework from a young age. Practicing martial arts every day would make it hard for her to get married. But Mulan didn't care what others thought.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了花木兰的出身背景，她自幼跟随父亲习武，但街坊邻居因她不拘传统女性形象而嘲笑她，而她对此毫不在意。

page_text_ocr_zh:
征兵的消息很快传到虞城，京城来的官员正挨家挨户地征集青壮年男子参军。
花弧一家也接到了通知。
page_text_en:
The news of conscription quickly reached Yucheng. Officials from the capital were going door to door to recruit young and strong men to join the army.
Hua Hu's family also received the notice.
summary_zh: 征兵令传到虞城，京城官员挨家挨户征兵，花弧一家也收到了征兵通知。

page_text_ocr_zh:
花弧年老多病，木兰又没有兄长，她的弟弟岁数
还小，花家实在没有合适的人选。
花弧拿出已经落满灰尘的盔甲，决定带着它去军营报到。
看着父亲花白的头发、苍老的脸庞和布满老茧的双手，木兰心疼不已。
page_text_en:
Hua Hu was old and sick, Mulan had no older brother, and her younger brother was still too young. The Hua family truly had no suitable candidate.
Hua Hu took out his armor, covered in dust, and decided to take it to the military camp for registration.
Looking at her father's white hair, aged face, and hands covered in calluses, Mulan felt deeply heartbroken.
summary_zh: 花木兰的父亲年老多病，弟弟年幼，家中无人可应征入伍。父亲决定亲自参军，木兰看到父亲苍老的模样，内心十分心疼。

page_text_ocr_zh:
她走到父亲身边，说道：“阿爷，您年岁已高，身上还有陈年旧伤，您不能去参军。”“强敌来犯，岂有不去之理！”“阿爷！”“不要再劝了。”
“阿爷，我替您去参军！我跟您学过兵法武艺，可以去打仗，保家卫国！”
“一个女孩子家，怎么能上战场！”“阿爷，我可以女扮男装呀。再说，自古以来有多少巾帼英雄留下美名，女子哪一点不如男子！”
“话虽如此，但女孩子家在战场上，万一被人看出来，那还了得！”“我一定小心谨慎，不露出破绽！”
page_text_en:
She walked up to her father and said, "Father, you are old, and still have old injuries. You can't go to war." "The enemy is coming. How can we not go?" "Father!" "Don't persuade me any more." 
"Father, let me go in your place! I've learned martial arts and military strategy from you. I can fight and protect our home and country!" 
"A girl like you? How can you go to the battlefield?" "Father, I can dress up as a man. Besides, since ancient times, how many heroic women have left their names in history? In what way are women inferior to men?" 
"That may be true, but if a girl is discovered on the battlefield, what then?" "I will be extremely careful and not reveal any clues!"
summary_zh: 花木兰看到父亲年迈体弱，决定替父从军，她向父亲表明自己学过武艺，可以女扮男装上战场保家卫国，父亲虽有顾虑，但被她的决心打动。

page_text_ocr_zh:
最终，木兰说服了父亲。
第二天，木兰挽起长发，穿上阿爷的
盔甲和战袍，英姿飒爽、意气风发地走出
家门，家里人差点都认不出她了。
page_text_en:
Finally, Mulan convinced her father.
The next day, Mulan tied up her long hair, put on her father's
armor and battle robes, and walked out of the house with a heroic and spirited demeanor.
Her family could hardly recognize her.
summary_zh: 花木兰说服父亲后，第二天便女扮男装，穿上父亲的盔甲和战袍，英姿飒爽地走出家门，家人几乎认不出她了。

page_text_ocr_zh: 她到集市上买了最好的马匹、马鞍和缰绳，威风凛凛地来到军营报到，没有人看出木兰是女子。
page_text_en: She went to the market, bought the finest horse, saddle, and reins, and arrived at the military camp in a commanding manner. No one realized that Mulan was a woman.
summary_zh: 花木兰女扮男装，购置了马匹和装备，威风凛凛地前往军营报到，无人识破其女子身份。

page_text_ocr_zh:
在军营中，木兰和其他士兵同吃同住同操练，异常小心地隐藏着自己的身份。
木兰还在这里结识了一位至交好友。他英武雄壮，胆略过人，与木兰一同参军，经常和木兰一起习武演练。木兰非常欣赏他。
page_text_en:
In the military camp, Mulan lives, eats, and trains with the other soldiers, carefully hiding her identity.
Mulan also makes a close friend here. He is brave and strong, with great courage and strategy. He enlisted with Mulan and often practices martial arts with her. Mulan greatly admires him.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了花木兰在军营中与士兵同吃同住同训练，并结识了一位英武的战友，两人常一起习武，木兰对他十分欣赏。

page_text_ocr_zh:
一开始，不论是作战还是日常训练，木兰都没有什么耀眼的成绩。军官嫌她身形柔弱，经常罚她单独训练。
“男子汉保家卫国，不仅要有胆识，更要有强壮的体魄。”
“大人，木兰刚刚从军，过不了多久，她一定会成为骁勇善战的战士！”好友总是暗中帮助木兰。在他的鼓励下，木兰越发刻苦用功，进步很快。
page_text_en:
At first, whether in combat or daily training, Mulan did not achieve any outstanding results. The officer criticized her for her frail physique and often punished her with solo training.
"A man defending his country must not only have courage, but also strong physical strength."
"Sir, Mulan has just joined the army. In no time, she will surely become a brave and valiant warrior!" Her good friend always secretly helped Mulan. Encouraged by him, Mulan worked harder and improved rapidly.
summary_zh: 花木兰初入军营时因身形柔弱表现平平，受到军官责罚，但在一位战友的鼓励下，她愈发刻苦训练，进步迅速。

page_text_ocr_zh:
柔然族率领大军攻打北部要塞，木兰跟随大部队渡过黄河、穿过平原、越过高山，来到前线。
这次战斗中，木兰目睹了柔然族的血腥残忍。她的战友倒下了一个又一个，挚友也不幸牺牲了，血水染红了草甸。凛冽的北风吹过，木兰的泪水结成了冰。
她痛彻心扉，发誓一定要为战友报仇，将敌人赶回老家去。
page_text_en:
The Rouran tribe led a large army to attack the northern fortress. Mulan followed the main force across the Yellow River, through the plains, over the mountains, and arrived at the front line.
In this battle, Mulan witnessed the brutal cruelty of the Rouran tribe. Her comrades fell one after another, and her close friend was also tragically killed. Blood stained the meadow. The biting northern wind blew, and Mulan's tears froze into ice.
She was heartbroken and vowed to avenge her comrades, driving the enemies back to their homeland.
summary_zh: 花木兰随军抵达前线，在一场惨烈的战斗中目睹战友接连牺牲，她悲痛欲绝，立誓为战友报仇，将敌人赶回老家。

page_text_ocr_zh:
与柔然族的仗，打了十二年。
十二年的血雨腥风，让木兰从一个一文不名的士兵成长为
一位具有雄才伟略的将军。只要她出征，战斗很少会失手。
page_text_en:
The war against the Rouran tribe lasted twelve years.
Twelve years of blood and storms turned Mulan from an unknown soldier into a general of great talent and strategy. Whenever she led a campaign, battles rarely ended in defeat.
summary_zh: 本页描述了花木兰与柔然族作战十二年，从一名普通士兵成长为拥有雄才伟略的将军，且战无不胜。

page_text_ocr_zh:
木兰率领军队东征西讨，
出生入死，白天刀光剑影，夜晚枕戈待旦。
一天晚上，月光凄冷，木兰在营前巡哨，看见一群飞鸟自北而来，她料定有大批敌军偷袭，便排兵布阵，做好准备。
page_text_en:
Mulan led her army in campaigns east and west,
fighting for survival, with swords and blades flashing by day, and resting with weapons at hand by night.
One night, under the cold moonlight, Mulan was on patrol in front of the camp. She saw a flock of birds flying from the north, and she deduced that a large enemy force was about to launch a surprise attack. She immediately arranged her troops and prepared for battle.
summary_zh: 花木兰率领军队征战四方，日夜操练，警惕敌情。某夜她巡哨时发现飞鸟自北而来，判断敌军将至，立即布阵备战。

page_text_ocr_zh: 等敌军到来时，伏兵从四面涌出，杀得敌人抱头鼠窜，大败而逃。历尽千辛万苦，木兰率领的军队终于击溃了柔然族，他们再也不敢南下侵犯北魏的百姓了。
page_text_en: When the enemy army arrived, ambush troops surged out from all sides, routing the enemy who fled in panic. After enduring countless hardships, Mulan's army finally defeated the Rouran tribe, who never again dared to invade the people of Northern Wei.
summary_zh: 花木兰率军设伏，大败敌军，最终击溃柔然族，使其不敢再侵犯北魏百姓。

page_text_ocr_zh:
军队凯旋，君王决定重赏木兰。
“木兰将军，你为国家立下了汗马功劳，你想要什么，
是高官厚禄，还是当朕的驸马爷，朕都可以赐予你！
“陛下，为国杀敌是我应尽的义务，能保家卫国我
感到无限的荣光！经年累月的战争已经消耗了太多的人
力财力，我不敢再向国家索要其他赏赐，只希望陛下
赐我一匹千里马，让我早日还乡，见到我日夜
思念的亲人！
君王欣赏木兰不慕名利，立刻恩准，赐予了木兰最
好的马匹。
page_text_en:
The army returned victorious, and the king decided to reward Mulan.
"General Mulan, you have rendered great service to the nation. What would you like? High office and wealth, or to become my son-in-law? I can grant you anything!"
"Your Majesty, defending the country is my duty. Being able to protect my home and nation brings me infinite honor! Years of war have consumed too much manpower and resources. I dare not ask for any further rewards from the state. I only hope Your Majesty will grant me a thousand-mile horse, so I can return home soon and see my beloved family!"
The king admired Mulan's lack of greed for fame and fortune, immediately granted her wish, and bestowed upon her the finest horse.
summary_zh: 花木兰率军凯旋，君王欲重赏她，她婉拒高官厚禄和驸马之位，只求一匹千里马以便早日归家见亲人，君王欣然应允。

page_text_ocr_zh:
听闻木兰要回乡，虞城的父老乡亲都出来迎接，争相目睹这位英雄的伟貌英姿。之前嘲笑过木兰的街坊邻居，此时也对木兰交口称赞。

木兰的父母、姐弟喜出望外，赶紧打扫房屋，宰杀猪羊，准备好丰盛的饭菜，等待十二年未见的木兰归来。木兰终于见到了朝思暮想的亲人，他们涕泪涟涟，相拥而泣。
page_text_en:
Hearing that Mulan was returning home, the elders and villagers of Yucheng came out to welcome her, eager to see the heroic figure of this great warrior. Even the neighbors who had once mocked Mulan now praised her enthusiastically.

Mulan’s parents and siblings were overjoyed. They hurried to clean the house, slaughter pigs and sheep, and prepare a lavish feast, waiting for Mulan’s return after twelve long years. Mulan finally saw her beloved family, and they wept with joy, embracing each other tightly.
summary_zh: 花木兰凯旋归乡，虞城父老纷纷迎接，昔日嘲笑她的邻居也纷纷称赞。家人喜出望外，准备丰盛饭菜迎接她，木兰与亲人相拥而泣，场面感人。

page_text_ocr_zh:
木兰来到自己的闺房，脱去厚厚的战袍，将头发轻轻地放下梳理，插上金钗，涂上胭脂粉黛。
木兰换好女装，出门来见父母和护送她回家的官兵。
同行的官兵瞠目结舌，待木兰细细解释后，无不啧啧惊叹，同行十二年，居然没有发觉木兰是一位女郎。
page_text_en:
Mulan came to her own bedroom, took off her thick battle robe, gently let down her hair and combed it, put on a golden hairpin, and applied rouge and powder.
Mulan changed into her woman's clothes and went out to meet her parents and the soldiers escorting her home.
The fellow soldiers were stunned, and after Mulan explained everything in detail, they all expressed amazement: after twelve years of serving together, they had never realized Mulan was a girl.
summary_zh: 花木兰凯旋归家后，在闺房中换回女装，与父母和护送她的官兵相见，同行的官兵得知她实为女子后无不惊叹。

page_text_ocr_zh:
花家终于得以团聚，所有人都簇拥在木兰身边，
听她诉说激动人心、惊心动魄的战斗场景。
虞城的父老乡亲为了纪念这位女英雄，建造了一
座壮丽的木兰祠，供后世瞻仰。
page_text_en:
The Hua family was finally reunited, and everyone gathered around Mulan,
listening to her recount the thrilling and heart-stopping battle scenes.
The people of Yucheng built a magnificent Mulan Temple to honor this female hero,
for future generations to admire.
summary_zh: 花木兰与家人团聚，向乡亲们讲述战斗经历，虞城百姓为纪念她建造了木兰祠。
